82429.subject: Sky Moves to Halt New Borrowing on Legacy Vaults
82429.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* [**Sky**](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/sky-advisor-proposes-halting-new-core-vault-borrowing)[ may stop new borrowing on five legacy vaults](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/sky-advisor-proposes-halting-new-core-vault-borrowing)

* [**LlamaRisk**](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/llamarisk-proposes-borrowing-speed-limits-for-aave-v3)[ proposed borrowing speed limits for Aave](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/llamarisk-proposes-borrowing-speed-limits-for-aave-v3)

* [**Bitcoin**](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-breaks-below-72-000-as-multiweek-slide-deepens)[ fell below $72,000, and ether neared $2,000](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-breaks-below-72-000-as-multiweek-slide-deepens)

* [**Binance**](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-says-hack-assets-covered-reserve-proof-pending)[ says hack losses are covered, proof pending](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/binance-says-hack-assets-covered-reserve-proof-pending)

* [**Tether**](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/usdt-freeze-proposals-on-tron-leave-time-to-move-funds)['s Tron freezes name targets before they execute](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/usdt-freeze-proposals-on-tron-leave-time-to-move-funds)

Three DeFi lenders moved this week to make new borrowing harder. Bitcoin fell below $72,000 on the same day the third proposal landed. What are the lenders are guarding against, and who pays for it?

**Sky**, formerly MakerDAO, issues the USDS and DAI stablecoins against collateral. On Thursday its risk advisor, BA Labs, [proposed stopping new borrowing](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/sky-advisor-proposes-halting-new-core-vault-borrowing) from five legacy ether and wstETH vault types. Those vaults hold 376.33 million USDS of debt across 771 positions. **Aave** is the largest DeFi lender, and LlamaRisk manages its risk settings. On Wednesday LlamaRisk [proposed a borrowing speed limit](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/llamarisk-proposes-borrowing-speed-limits-for-aave-v3) that refills a capped buffer every 30 minutes. **Moonwell**, a lender on Base and Optimism, [cut collateral limits](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/moonwell-cuts-collateral-limits-drops-velo-and-wrseth) the same day.

Moonwell, Binance and Aave each had an attack to deal with in the past four months. In August an attacker [took about $8.7 million from Moonwell](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/moonwell-loses-8-7-million-to-mamo-price-manipulation-on-base) by pushing up the price of MAMO and borrowing against it. Binance's October hack, which it puts at $6.3 billion, reached Aave next. A wallet in the attacker's cluster borrowed WETH on Aave, and LlamaRisk froze Aave markets across chains. Aave [reopened them on Oct. 30](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-reopens-markets-but-keeps-nine-assets-at-zero-ltv) after removing about $3.7 billion of unused V3 borrowing capacity. Sky's total value locked [fell 15% in the week to Nov. 7](
